svg.title: Lee–Wang quadric shrinker
svg.desc: Exact real slice in R³ · the full example is a three-manifold in C³

g.text: Exact real slice in R³ · the full example is a three-manifold in C³
x₁² + x₂² − x₃² = 2 · n = 3, k = 2, s = 0
The full circle quotient is connected; this drawing omits the circle parameter.
